# temporary file for checking that the regression models are correct

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(brms)
```

```{r}
dep_var <- "p600"
models <- list.files(file.path("analysis", "brms_models"),
    full.names = TRUE,
    pattern = paste0(dep_var, "_.*\\.rds$")
)
model <- models[5]

print(model)
m <- readRDS(model)
summary(m)
```

```{r}
plot(m)
plot(m, pars = "^b_")
```
